official_source.title: WJEC Eduqas GCSE (9-1) in English Literature specification (teaching from 2015)
official_source.note: Version 4 replaces the Component 1 Section B poetry anthology with a new anthology assessed for the first time in 2027.

anthology_source.title: WJEC Eduqas GCSE (9-1) English Literature Poetry Anthology (C720) for first assessment from 2027

approach: Official Eduqas prescribed texts, scoped to the owner’s route. No textbook organisation has been supplied.

route.component_1: Macbeth (Section A) and the Poetry Anthology for assessment from 2027 (Section B)
route.component_2: An Inspector Calls (Section A), A Christmas Carol (Section B) and unseen poetry (Section C)
route.evidence: Owner’s answers, 16 November 2026 (recorded in project memory)

options_not_in_scope.Component 1 Section A: Romeo and Juliet, Othello, Much Ado About Nothing, Twelfth Night, The Merchant of Venice (Henry V in earlier papers)
options_not_in_scope.Component 2 Section A: Lord of the Flies, Anita and Me, Boys Don’t Cry, The Woman in Black, Oranges are not the Only Fruit, The Curious Incident of the Dog in the Night-Time, Leave Taking, The History Boys, Blood Brothers (Never Let Me Go and A Taste of Honey in earlier papers)
options_not_in_scope.Component 2 Section B: Silas Marner, War of the Worlds, Pride and Prejudice, Jane Eyre, The Strange Case of Dr Jekyll and Mr Hyde
options_not_in_scope.Poetry anthology examined until 2026: The Manhunt, Sonnet 43, London, The Soldier, She Walks in Beauty, Living Space, As Imperceptibly as Grief, Cozy Apologia, Valentine, A Wife in London, Death of a Naturalist, Hawk Roosting, To Autumn, Afternoons, Dulce et Decorum Est, Ozymandias, Mametz Wood, Excerpt from The Prelude

C720U10-1.title: Shakespeare and Poetry
C720U10-1.structure: A Shakespeare: extract question (15) and essay (25) on one play; B anthology poetry: one poem (15) and a comparison (25)

C720U20-1.title: Post-1914 Prose/Drama, 19th Century Prose and Unseen Poetry
C720U20-1.structure: A post-1914 text (40), B 19th century novel (40), C unseen poem (15) and comparison (25)

notes: Leaves are the route’s set texts and the 2027 anthology poems in Eduqas’s printed order. Eduqas prints no codes; codes are positional.

topics.title: Section A: Shakespeare: Macbeth
topics.route: Component 1 Section A (one play from the prescribed list)

points.title: Macbeth
content: Macbeth, William Shakespeare.

One extract-based question (15 marks) and one essay on the play as a whole (25 marks, including 5 for spelling, punctuation and the use of vocabulary and sentence structures). Assesses AO1, AO2 and AO4.

sections.title: Component 2: Post-1914 Prose/Drama, 19th Century Prose and Unseen Poetry

topics.title: Section A: Post-1914 drama: An Inspector Calls
topics.route: Component 2 Section A (one prose or drama text from the prescribed list)

points.title: An Inspector Calls
content: An Inspector Calls, J B Priestley.
One source-based question using an extract and the play as a whole (40 marks, including 5 for spelling, punctuation and the use of vocabulary and sentence structures). Assesses AO1, AO2 and AO4.

topics.title: Section B: 19th century prose: A Christmas Carol
topics.route: Component 2 Section B (one novel from the prescribed list)

points.title: A Christmas Carol
content: A Christmas Carol, Charles Dickens.
One source-based question using an extract and the novel as a whole (40 marks). Assesses AO1, AO2 and AO3.

topics.title: Section C: Unseen poetry
topics.route: Component 2 Section C (compulsory: two unseen 20th or 21st century poems)

points.title: Unseen poem: single poem response
content: Write about a previously unseen poem from the 20th or 21st century and its effect (15 marks; AO1, AO2).

points.title: Unseen poems: comparison
content: Write about a second unseen poem and compare it with the first (25 marks; AO1, AO2).
